title: 捷運最少坐幾站
question: 捷運有 n 個車站，編號 0 到 n - 1；有 m 段軌道，每段連接兩個車站，兩個方向都能坐。請輸入 n、m，再輸入每段軌道連接的兩個車站，最後輸入起點和終點，輸出最少要坐幾站；到不了就輸出「到不了」。

en.title: Fewest MRT Stops
en.question: An MRT has n stations, numbered 0 to n - 1. There are m tracks. Each track joins two stations, both ways. Input n and m, then the two stations of each track, then the start and the end. Output the fewest stops. If you cannot get there, output "Cannot get there".
